Filed from the vale-md hook's shipped profile (`hooks/vale-md/.vale.ini`: SentenceLength >25w, SlopWords, LatinAbbrev; Dashes disabled), swept over every tracked `.md` at 0.21.2 (PR #1918). Cleanup is scoped to **living doctrine surfaces only** — the record surfaces are listed at the bottom and are out of scope by repo convention.

## Ground rules for the cleanup

- **Advisory means advisory.** Shorten and simplify only where the prose reads better after; a finding is a prompt, not a mandate.
- **Never reword pinned literals.** Drift-guard pinned strings, the ratified `docs/learnings/` pointer line (byte-identical across surfaces), extraction headings (`## Commander's Intent` etc., ADR 0014), and the war-strategy SKILL §2 templates (structure-test locked) stay byte-identical. Run the full JS + shell suites after every file.
- **Budgeted surfaces ratchet down.** SKILL/reference files carrying ADR 0042 advisory/hard byte lines welcome shrinkage; never raise a line to fit a rewrite.
- **One PR per surface family** (skills, agents, root docs) keeps the serial-merge rebase risk down; same-file collisions with in-flight plans should defer.

## Out of scope (records — do not reword)

| surface | findings | why excluded |
|---|---:|---|
| `docs/plans/` | 8483 | landed plans are ratified execution artifacts |
| `docs/specs/` | 4771 | consumed input artifacts |
| `docs/learnings/` | 3070 | provenance-tagged lesson records (RESOLVED bodies are frozen; archive moves are never rewrites) |
| `docs/red-team/` | 1458 | historical verification reports |
| `docs/adr/` | 922 | ADRs are immutable decision records |
| `docs/roadmaps/` | 204 | consumed campaign records |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | 203 | recovered release blurbs, near-verbatim by design |
| `hooks/reply-standard/card.md` | 5 | byte-for-byte per the author's instructions |
